data.one_liner: Flutter widgets to display country, language, and timezone flags.
data.what_it_does: Provides a set of widgets and enums to render flags of countries, languages, and timezones using SVG assets. Supports loading flags via specific enums or custom code strings.
use_when: You need to display country flags in your Flutter application.
You need to display language or timezone flags easily using widgets.
avoid_when: You need automated testing support, as tests are currently missing.
You need to dynamically load flags from the internet via network URLs.
strengths: Easy to use with dedicated widgets like CountryFlag, LanguageFlag, and TimezoneFlag.
Supports lookup by standard codes or enums.
weaknesses: No built-in method to fetch flags directly from the internet.
